title: Replacing leaking 250,000-gallon Haʻikū water tank
summary: A grant would replace a deteriorated 250,000-gallon water tank in Haikū. The council is adding federal EPA water grants to the fiscal year 2025 budget, and the Haikū tank is one of the projects they would pay for.
